baseline.entry_point: Frozen DPR Reader relevance head -> fixed Top-50 -> Top-5 ordering
baseline.equivalence_test: Raw Reader relevance logits and null residual reproduce stable Top-5 exactly.

core_invariants: Top-50 -> Top-5 scope and production retrieval/selector/Generator/evaluator remain frozen.
Reader-side online head receives no gold, Silver, generation, or evaluator fields.
Weak answer-string containment is training-only and not official passage gold.
Quantum and classical arms use the same split, loss, optimizer, seed, and parameter count.
Silver labels are opened only after all online arms rank all cases.

interfaces.input_schema: Reader relevance/start/end logits plus passage-token mask

scope: fixed Top-50 to Top-5 selector screening with a Reader-integrated trainable head

plugins.insertion_point: DPR Reader relevance head before Top-5
plugins.hypothesis: Raw Reader relevance is the stable anchor.
plugins.input_schema: Reader relevance logit and candidate rank
plugins.online: raw DPR Reader relevance logit stable Top-5

plugins.hypothesis: A learned four-qubit gate opens a bounded residual only for reliable span rescue.
plugins.input_schema: Reader relevance/start/end logits and passage-token mask
plugins.resource_estimate: Frozen Reader plus four-qubit Torch head on 512 weak cases
plugins.online: Reader relevance anchor plus four-qubit applicability-gated bounded residual

plugins.hypothesis: Task gains must exceed a matched classical control before quantum attribution.
plugins.resource_estimate: Same Torch parameter budget and optimizer
plugins.online: matched diagonal classical feature layers, same parameter count/loss/split/seed

composition.merge_rule: Each arm scores the unchanged Reader cohort; no arm feeds another.

validation.baseline_equivalence: Null residual reproduces raw Reader scores exactly.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open/train weak slice plus registered detail input hash 669ce101...d5731
reproducibility.environment: Collaborator-local Torch/Transformers/Hugging Face cache and Wiki-DPR

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: all 100 cases and all three arms; no raw passage text
trace_contract.target_boundary: Silver/evidence is posthoc-only; no labels in online head
readiness_checks: raw text absent from compact files

gates.utility: Q-ARCG mean Silver overlap exceeds frozen Reader Top-k with paired bootstrap lower bound >= 0
gates.attribution: Q-ARCG mean Silver overlap exceeds matched classical control with paired bootstrap lower bound > 0
gates.claim_ceiling: L0 diagnostic until official gold and independent utility are available

kill_criteria: online boundary receives labels or generated/evaluator fields
Q-ARCG does not beat frozen Reader and matched classical control on predeclared paired diagnostics
gate systematically promotes low-relevance sharp-span false positives

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Gate-open rate and paired rank rescue in middle-relevance/low-disagreement candidates against Reader and matched classical control.

limitations: L0 diagnostic only: weak containment is noisy and Silver overlap is posthoc.
The Reader body is frozen; this is a trainable Reader-side head screen, not end-to-end fine-tuning.
The four-qubit statevector is classically simulable; no quantum advantage is claimed.
